contrast: GSE217413 UM-UC-3 CisR mean CPM versus WT mean CPM
input: author CAGE CPM, human Ensembl.version__symbol; not raw counts
filter: mean CPM across 4 samples >=1; abs log2((CR mean+0.1)/(WT mean+0.1)) >=2
selection: up to 100 genes per direction; descending absolute log2 ratio then lexical gene symbol; uniquely mapped human genes only
score: mean(gene z in UP)-mean(gene z in DN); separately versioned derived program
independence: GSE217413 itself is derivation/internal comparison, not independent validation
published_program: separate BLOCKED_LABELS if full 2284-gene published membership cannot be resolved; supplementary PDF is full CPM table, not labeled DEG list
